summary: NRx Pharmaceuticals' subsidiary NRx Defense Systems entered a prime contract with DARPA on September 29, 2026 to run the SPARC-TMS clinical trial of robotic neuro-navigated transcranial magnetic stimulation combined with NRX-101 for treatment-resistant depression. The contract totals roughly $11.2 million, with $6.7 million initially obligated and the remainder subject to appropriations and DARPA funding options, over an 18-month performance period with milestone-based payments. NRx Defense retains invention ownership subject to a DARPA nonexclusive license. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is involved.
